Attributions prepared for the explicitly pinned JPEG component in Turnos en Común.
This file is not claimed to be an upstream PDF.js NOTICE file.

JPEG decoder source: Mozilla/pdf.js commit 11ab3b5c000eb13e7ea5632ac36b1109ff7280b7,
src/core/jpg.js. Copyright 2014 Mozilla Foundation.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see pdfjs-jpeg-LICENSE.txt.

The source states that it was forked from https://github.com/notmasteryet/jpgjs
and that the original version was created by GitHub user notmasteryet.
Antecedent attribution: Copyright (C) 2011 notmasteryet.
Contributors identified by that project's license: Yury Delendik and Brendan Dahl.

Local modifications: ESM interface and a local warning adapter only; the
decoder algorithm is unchanged from the identified source. The surrounding
UTIF 3.1.0 container code (Copyright (c) 2017 Photopea, MIT) has its old minified
JPEG block removed and delegates to this separately attributed component.

The historical source revision used to create the removed minified block was
not identified. This replacement is not represented as that historical source.
